task: Make spreadsheets with formulas on this computer

x-display.title: Work with spreadsheets in Grist
x-display.summary: Work with tables and formulas in a browser-based spreadsheet workspace on your computer.
x-display.description: Use Grist for records you want to organise and calculate with, such as an inventory or a project tracker. This recipe opens the application for ongoing work, so you can return to your documents and keep editing them.

packaging_note: Use the Dokploy image and persistent workspace with a single local user and organization.
licence: Apache-2.0. The store template retains its licence in TEMPLATE-LICENSE.

access.why: The service uses a container network to serve its local address.

known_issues: The workspace opens as its local owner. Other programs on this computer can access this loopback service.
